headline: Crude bomb explodes in front of Supreme Court in Dhaka
summary: The blast occurred shortly after the International Crimes Tribunal-2 sentenced seven Awami League leaders to death for atrocities during the July Uprising.
details: A crude bomb exploded in front of the Supreme Court in Dhaka around 1:15 pm this afternoon. Police are currently working to identify the individuals responsible for detonating the device.
The incident took place approximately one hour after the International Crimes Tribunal-2 delivered a significant verdict.
The tribunal sentenced Awami League General Secretary Obaidul Quader and six other leaders to death in a crimes against humanity case.
The convicts include former state minister Mohammad Ali Arafat, AFM Bahauddin Nasim, Sheikh Fazle Shams Parash, Moinul Hossain Nikhil, Saddam Hussain, and Sheikh Wali Asif Enan.
The charges relate to atrocities committed during the July Uprising in 2024.
Shahbagh Police Station Inspector Mainul Islam confirmed the explosion and stated that law enforcement is pursuing leads to find the suspects.
caption:
A crude bomb blast rocks the Supreme Court area in Dhaka shortly after a major death sentence verdict.

A crude bomb exploded in front of the Supreme Court in Dhaka around 1:15 pm this afternoon. Police are currently working to identify the individuals responsible for detonating the device.

The incident took place approximately one hour after the International Crimes Tribunal-2 delivered a significant verdict.

The tribunal sentenced Awami League General Secretary Obaidul Quader and six other leaders to death in a crimes against humanity case.

The convicts include former state minister Mohammad Ali Arafat, AFM Bahauddin Nasim, Sheikh Fazle Shams Parash, Moinul Hossain Nikhil, Saddam Hussain, and Sheikh Wali Asif Enan.

The charges relate to atrocities committed during the July Uprising in 2024.

Shahbagh Police Station Inspector Mainul Islam confirmed the explosion and stated that law enforcement is pursuing leads to find the suspects.

headline: 7 deaths, 1,593 hospitalisations Dengue surge continues in 24 hours
summary: Total deaths have risen to 164 as thousands of patients are currently undergoing treatment across the country.
details: At least seven dengue patients died and 1,593 others were hospitalised in the 24 hours leading up to 8:00 am today.
The deaths were reported across multiple regions, with two deaths in Khulna division and one each in Dhaka, Barishal, Mymensingh, Rajshahi, and Rangpur divisions.
With these latest figures, the total number of dengue deaths has reached 164, while total cases have risen to 1,593.
Currently, 4,058 dengue patients are undergoing treatment in various hospitals across Bangladesh.
